translations.web: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
translations.bsb: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
translations.kjv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
translations.asv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.
